title: New infinite families of $q$-analogs of group divisible designs with arbitrary block dimension
summary: This paper is mainly devoted to constructions of \(q\)-analogs of group divisible designs and their applications. We give a complete description of the action of \(G=\GL(m,q^l)\) on \(Ω_k^{k-1}\), where $3\leq k\leq \min\left\lbrace m+1,l\right\rbrace $ and \(Ω_k^{k-1}\) is the set of \(k\)-subspaces of $\GF(q)^{ml}$ whose \(\GF(q^l)\)-span has dimension \(k-1\). We do this by relating the \(G\)-orbits on \(Ω_k^{k-1}\) to the corresponding Singer cycle orbits on subspaces of $\GF(q)^l$.
